description: This is a bash shell script for generating U-Boot FIT image source files (.its files). It manages multi-image and multi-configuration support, including image data encoding, checksums, signatures, and the generation of device tree source snippets for embedded Linux boot images.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script, detailing command-line options.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line inputs to set variables for architecture, version, images, and configurations.

methods.name: value_sanity_chk
methods.description: Validates signatures, hash algorithms, and compression types against allowed options.

methods.name: emit_its
methods.description: Outputs sections of the .its file, including headers, image, configuration, and end sections.

methods.name: emit_kernel
methods.description: Generates a kernel node in the .its file with specified properties.

methods.name: emit_fdt
methods.description: Generates a device tree blob node in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_ramdisk
methods.description: Generates a ramdisk node in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_cksum
methods.description: Outputs checksum subnodes for signatures and hash algorithms.

methods.name: emit_signature
methods.description: Outputs signature subnodes with specified algorithms and keys for images.

methods.name: emit_config
methods.description: Generates configuration subnodes including kernel, FDT, ramdisk, and signatures.

methods.name: remove_prefix_space
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from input strings for clean output formatting.

methods.name: emit_image_nodes
methods.description: Generates all image nodes (kernel, fdt, ramdisk) and their subnodes based on input arrays.

methods.name: emit_configuration_nodes
methods.description: Generates configuration nodes with associated images and signatures.
